Definition: the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east)
BiblicalUsage: 1) south, southward, whatever is on the right (so the southern quarter), south wind; 1a) south (of territory); 1b) southern quarter (of the sky); 1c) toward the south, southward (of direction); 1d) south wind
